chunks: Abu Baṣīr narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"If you are in a hurry, then perform the Salat of Jaʿfar in a stripped form, then make up the tasbih afterward."

key_terms.التَّسْبِيحَ: the glorifications recited in this prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةَ جَعْفَرٍ: the Salat attributed to Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib
key_terms.مُجَرَّدَةً: without the usual additional form; in a simplified manner
key_terms.مُسْتَعْجِلًا: being in haste or pressed for time

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they are in a hurry while performing Salat Jaʿfar?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a practical ruling regarding Salat Jaʿfar when one is pressed for time. It permits performing the prayer in a simplified form and completing the tasbih later, showing facilitation in worship.
